note: The scene number from the script. A scene inserted after locked pages takes a letter — 24A as a scene is distinct from 24A as a setup.

source_key: Each new camera setup within the scene advances the letter — 24, 24A, 24B. The first setup is the master setup and carries no letter. I, O and S are often skipped because they can be misread as numerals when handwritten. See notation/movielabs-omc for the formalised version of this same convention.
